description: Frozen benchmark and bounded-experiment matrix for Jcode Rust development feedback tuning.

execution_policy.coordinated_duplicate_exception: Duplicate requests are submitted concurrently only through the existing server-owned selfdev coordinator; the coordinator and global Cargo gate must still authorize one underlying Cargo action.

source_preparation.instructions: Complete one unmeasured priming run, then touch the declared representative Rust source file without changing its contents before each measured check or build sample.

scenarios.command_intent: Measure warm incremental cargo check and development-profile build feedback through scripts/dev_cargo.sh for one representative touched Rust file.

source_preparation.instructions: Create an isolated worktree at the recorded revision with a scenario-specific target directory and no reusable incremental artifacts before each sample.

scenarios.command_intent: Measure a development-profile build from a fresh worktree and cold target state through scripts/dev_cargo.sh.

source_preparation.instructions: Use the recorded package, target, feature set, and known matching test filter against an unchanged prepared source state.

scenarios.command_intent: Measure one eligible focused Cargo test request while preserving explicit package, target, feature, and Cargo filter semantics.

source_preparation.instructions: Use a current complete discovery snapshot and a recorded package/filter combination proven to select zero tests.

scenarios.command_intent: Measure visible rejection of a provably empty focused test request before avoidable selfdev queue and Cargo-gate waiting.

source_preparation.instructions: Use the recorded source state and invoke the established broad all-target and all-feature validation command without inferred narrowing.

scenarios.command_intent: Measure the unchanged broad full-feature validation path used as the correctness and release-confidence guardrail.

source_preparation.instructions: Submit equivalent requests from multiple isolated clients to one long-lived server at the same recorded source state.

scenarios.command_intent: Measure server-owned duplicate coalescing and follower behavior while proving one coordinator-authorized underlying Cargo action.

experiment_variants.eligibility: Equivalent isolated one-action warm, cold, focused-test, and broad-validation scenarios using the existing adaptive scripts/dev_cargo.sh job policy.
experiment_variants.experiment_boundary: Baseline policy for comparison; do not alter coordinator ownership, the global Cargo gate, features, target scope, or scenario preparation.
experiment_variants.fallback: Use the established adaptive scripts/dev_cargo.sh policy when any candidate is ineligible, invalid, or rejected.

experiment_variants.eligibility: Equivalent isolated one-action scenarios on a host with at least six logical CPUs and sufficient memory, compared against adaptive with all non-job configuration fixed.
experiment_variants.experiment_boundary: Set the existing explicit Cargo job override to 6 for benchmark samples only; never apply it to coordinated duplicate execution as uncontrolled parallel Cargo work.
experiment_variants.fallback: Revert to the established adaptive job policy when host eligibility, comparability, reliability, or p50/p95 adoption gates fail.

experiment_variants.eligibility: Equivalent isolated one-action scenarios on a host with at least eight logical CPUs and sufficient memory, compared against adaptive with all non-job configuration fixed.
experiment_variants.experiment_boundary: Set the existing explicit Cargo job override to 8 for benchmark samples only; never apply it to coordinated duplicate execution as uncontrolled parallel Cargo work.
experiment_variants.fallback: Revert to the established adaptive job policy when host eligibility, comparability, reliability, or p50/p95 adoption gates fail.

experiment_variants.eligibility: Focused-test scenarios whose package, target, features, filters, ignored/exact semantics, and harness arguments are supported equivalently by the installed cargo-nextest version.
experiment_variants.experiment_boundary: Bounded focused-test trial only; Cargo test remains the default and broad, invalid-zero-test, incompatible, unavailable, or ambiguous requests are excluded.
experiment_variants.fallback: Execute the established Cargo test path with unchanged arguments when nextest is unavailable, incompatible, invalid, slower, unstable, or rejected.

experiment_variants.eligibility: Cold or fresh-worktree non-incremental build scenarios with sccache installed, an isolated empty cache, and identical compiler, source, target, feature, and job configuration.
experiment_variants.experiment_boundary: One bounded cold-miss lane with incremental compilation disabled; never enable sccache for warm incremental development or change the default cache policy.
experiment_variants.fallback: Disable sccache and execute the established cold build path when setup, cache service, compatibility, reliability, resource, or adoption checks fail.

experiment_variants.eligibility: Cold or fresh-worktree non-incremental build scenarios following a valid matching cache-population sample with unchanged compiler, source, target, feature, and job identity.
experiment_variants.experiment_boundary: One bounded reusable-hit lane after the paired cold-miss lane; never reuse incompatible cache state or enable sccache for warm incremental development by default.
experiment_variants.fallback: Disable sccache and execute the established cold build path when cache identity, hit evidence, compatibility, reliability, resource, or adoption checks fail.
